name: Globe and Mail cryptic crossword No 3,131

clue.text: Imitative police officer last to annoy queen?

indicators.note: the final letter of the following word is the only one taken

blocks.note: a common informal word for a police officer
the closing letter of annoy
a queen is a female cat

explanation.surface: A police officer who mimics others has finally irritated the monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: A queen here is not royalty but a female cat, the standard breeder's term.
explanation.definitionFit: Used attributively, as in a copycat crime, the word describes something done in imitation of an earlier act.

clue.text: Remark about fellow, Democrat, one of ten?

indicators.note: about means around, so one word wraps the other pieces

blocks.note: a comment is a remark
a fellow is a man
D is the abbreviation for Democrat

explanation.surface: A remark about a Democratic man who is one of ten people.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition refers to the Ten Commandments given to Moses.
explanation.definitionFit: The Ten Commandments are the biblical laws, so any single rule among them fits the cryptic count.

clue.text: Game — option periodically used before formal event

indicators.note: at regular periods along the word, every second letter is kept

blocks.note: second, fourth and sixth letters of option
a ball is a formal dance

explanation.surface: A game option that is sometimes played before a gala.
explanation.definitionFit: Pinball is an arcade amusement where players flip a steel ball around a sloping table.

clue.text: End of spin in unusual motor car, a flier!

indicators.note: only the closing letter of the following word is kept
unusual means out of the normal order, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: the final letter of spin
the remaining letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: Someone finishes a spin in a strange car and is airborne.
explanation.walkthrough: The flier is not a pilot or a leaflet but a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A cormorant is a large dark seabird, so it is a creature that flies.

clue.text: Ancient city article, matchless? Not entirely

indicators.note: not entirely means one letter short of the whole, so the last letter is cut

blocks.note: the definite article
matchless means unequalled, the best

explanation.surface: A writer asks whether a piece about an old city really was unrivalled.
explanation.definitionFit: Thebes was a major city of ancient Egypt and also a leading city-state in classical Greece.

clue.text: Firm, northeastern, solid

blocks.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm
the compass abbreviation

explanation.surface: A description of a sturdy company based in the northeast.
explanation.definitionFit: In geometry a cone is a three-dimensional figure, one of the classic solid shapes.

clue.text: Vehicle seen in America, Britain

indicators.note: seen in says the letters are visible inside the following words

blocks.note: spans the end of the first word and start of the second

explanation.surface: A type of car spotted on the roads of both America and Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: A cab is a taxi, a car hired with its driver for short journeys.

clue.text: Carer, not usually rattled, seemed edgy at first

indicators.note: at first points to the opening letter of each preceding word

blocks.note: the leading letters of the five words

explanation.surface: A normally calm carer seemed nervous at the start of a shift.
explanation.definitionFit: A nurse looks after the sick and injured, which is exactly the job of a caregiver.

clue.text: Less important vitamin — order reduced

indicators.note: both neighbouring words are cut down, leaving only a run of letters that straddles them

blocks.note: the tail of vitamin joined to the start of order

explanation.surface: A smaller vitamin order has been cut back, as a minor item on a shopping list.
explanation.walkthrough: Strip vita- from the first word and -der from the second; what remains runs straight through.
explanation.definitionFit: Something minor is of lesser significance or rank, a direct synonym for lower importance.

clue.text: Mob rage about trade restriction

indicators.note: about suggests turning things around, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: the letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: A crowd is furious about a ban on trade.
explanation.definitionFit: An embargo is an official ban on commerce with a particular country, a formal limit on trading.

clue.text: Moving up into sport, one seeing opening

indicators.note: moving means shifting position, so the letters move around

blocks.note: the letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: A player advancing into a sport after spotting a chance.
explanation.definitionFit: An opportunist seizes chances as they arise, someone always watching for an opening to exploit.

clue.text: Title, Afghan, regularly forgotten

indicators.note: every other letter is dropped at a steady interval, keeping the rest

blocks.note: first, third and fifth letters of Afghan

explanation.surface: Someone's Afghan title keeps slipping people's minds.
explanation.walkthrough: Aga is an Ottoman and Turkish honorific given to a military officer or chief.
explanation.definitionFit: An aga was a title of rank for a commander or official in the Ottoman Empire and nearby lands.

clue.text: Miss target time as eel proves slippery

indicators.note: something slippery slides about, so the letters will not stay in place

blocks.note: the letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: An angler misses the target because the eel is too slippery to hold.
explanation.definitionFit: To oversleep is to stay asleep beyond the hour intended, so waking late past the planned moment.

clue.text: Tilts toes awkwardly in these?

indicators.note: awkwardly suggests clumsy disorder, so the letters are jumbled

blocks.note: the letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: A wearer's feet are pitched at an uncomfortable angle in some footwear.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both the wordplay and a description of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Stilettos are very high, thin heels that force the foot to slope steeply forward onto the toes.

clue.text: Buck’s party everyone recalled, rave at the outset

indicators.note: recalled read as called back, so the word runs from its end
only the opening letter of the preceding word is kept

blocks.note: a do is an informal word for a party
all means everyone
the opening letter of rave

explanation.surface: A stag party, where everyone remembers a wild rave beginning.
explanation.walkthrough: A buck's party is the Australian name for a stag do, but here the 's is just 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Buck is North American slang for a single unit of currency, the dollar.

clue.text: Refuse young group

blocks.note: first meaning: rubbish scattered about
second meaning: a set of animals born to one mother at one time

explanation.walkthrough: Refuse reads as a verb meaning decline, but it is the noun for rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means discarded rubbish in public places and also a brood of puppies or kittens born together.

clue.text: Playhouse that welcomes English, extremely reasonable

indicators.note: to welcome is to take someone in, so one piece goes inside
extremely points to the two extreme ends of the following word

blocks.note: taken as written
E is the abbreviation for English
the first and last letters of reasonable

explanation.surface: A playhouse that welcomes English customers at very fair prices.
explanation.definitionFit: A theatre is a building where plays are staged, the same thing as a playhouse.

clue.text: Animal finally sick, clear up after it!

indicators.note: finally takes the last letter of the word that follows
in a down clue up means read from bottom to top, backwards

blocks.note: the final letter of sick
taken as written
to net is to clear as profit

explanation.surface: A pet owner is told to mop up after the animal has been sick.
explanation.walkthrough: Clear is not tidy but the money sense: to clear a sum is to net it after costs.
explanation.definitionFit: A kitten is a young cat, so it is a specific kind of creature.

clue.text: European shipmate upset — show compassion

indicators.note: upset means knocked over, so the letters fall into a new order

blocks.note: E is the abbreviation for European
the letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: A distressed sailor from Europe needs comfort and understanding.
explanation.definitionFit: To empathise is to share and understand another person's feelings, a form of fellow feeling.

clue.text: Tranquillity of bishop or knight, say?

indicators.note: say asks for the word as it would be spoken

blocks.note: bishop and knight are chess pieces

explanation.surface: A question about the calm of a churchman or a nobleman.
explanation.walkthrough: Bishop and knight look like people, but they are chessmen.
explanation.definitionFit: Peace is a state of calm and quiet, the same as tranquillity.

clue.text: Australian native, Mike, visiting European Union

indicators.note: a visitor goes inside someone else's place, so one piece sits within the other

blocks.note: the standard abbreviation
Mike is M in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: An Australian called Mike is on a trip to Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: The emu is a large flightless bird found only in Australia, so it is an indigenous creature there.

clue.text: Poles in characteristic movement

indicators.note: placed in means set inside another word

blocks.note: a trait is a characteristic
north and south are the two poles

explanation.surface: Polish people show a typical way of moving.
explanation.walkthrough: Poles looks like the nationality, but it means the north and south magnetic poles.
explanation.definitionFit: Transit is the act of passing or conveying from one place to another, a kind of travel.

clue.text: Heaven ultimately lasts a thousand years

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the following word

blocks.note: the final letter of lasts
K stands for a thousand, as in kilo
Y is the abbreviation for years

explanation.surface: In the end, paradise endures for a millennium.
explanation.definitionFit: The heavens is a poetic term for the sky, the expanse above the earth.

clue.text: Those introducing tune, uplifting, thankful, that is to be sung by all performers

definitions.text: to be sung by all performers

indicators.note: the letters that introduce each word are their opening ones

blocks.note: the leading letter of each of the five words

explanation.surface: A choir director describes an uplifting, grateful tune meant for everyone to join in.
explanation.definitionFit: Tutti is the Italian musical direction telling every voice or instrument to perform together.

clue.text: Damp, dreary on the outside, we returned inside

indicators.note: only the outer edge of the word is kept
returned means sent back, so the word runs from its end
inside places one piece within the other

blocks.note: the first and last letters of dreary
taken as written

explanation.surface: It is a damp, dreary day outside, so we came back indoors.
explanation.definitionFit: Dewy means moist with dew, the light wetness that forms on grass overnight.

clue.text: Beginning to develop new climb

blocks.note: N is the abbreviation for new
an ascent is a climb

explanation.surface: Someone is starting to train for a fresh climb.
explanation.definitionFit: Nascent describes something just coming into existence and showing early signs of growth.
